description: a young man with silver-white hair, dark grey leather armour and a dark cloak, a long curved sword in his right hand, seen from the side, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy
